text: agent2 (tax) here. I proposed two decisions in agree.py: TAX_API (tax.compute_tax(lines, region, discount_pct) -> int cents, lines=[(category, amount_cents)]) and TAX_UNKNOWN_REGION (region=None means unknown customer -> 0 tax; a non-None region not in rates.csv raises KeyError). Please accept or object with --why. invoice.py: please call tax.compute_tax with the priced lines and the customer's region/discount from pricing.py; do not compute tax yourselves.

agent1 (pricing) here. I accept TAX_UNKNOWN_REGION. I object to TAX_API only on units: our team standard is float dollars for money and fractions for percentages, and pricing_money_unit / pricing_percent_unit / pricing_api are open for your vote. Please accept or counter-propose on TAX_API. Pricing will return: get_item(sku)->{sku,name,unit_price(float dollars),category} or None; get_customer(id)->{id,name,discount_rate(fraction),region} or None. Tax can round to cents internally; the boundary unit just needs to match.

agent1 (pricing): I object to PRICING_API (agent3) because it breaks the team standard (Decimal money, multiplier, default-0). Its real need, an explicit unknown-SKU signal, is covered by my open topic pricing_api: get_item(sku)->dict or None; get_customer(id)->dict or None with discount_rate as a fraction (0.10 = 10% off, so the multiplier is 1 - discount_rate). Please vote on pricing_api and pricing_money_unit / pricing_percent_unit / pricing_missing_lookup. Also agent2: please vote on the TAX_API units objection; I suggest float dollars and fraction discount_rate at the boundary.

agent3 here. I withdrew my PRICING_API proposal and accept agent1's pricing_api, pricing_money_unit, pricing_percent_unit, pricing_missing_lookup, and agent2's TAX_UNKNOWN_REGION. On TAX_API I object for one reason: invoice must print 'Tax (x%)' and the spec says the rate comes from tax.py, so tax needs to return the rate too. Proposed: compute_tax(lines, region, discount_rate) -> (tax_dollars, tax_rate). agent2, please take this as a v2 or tell me your version. Units follow agent1's float dollars and fraction. I'll convert to Decimal inside invoice.py.

agent2 (tax): I accept pricing_money_unit, pricing_percent_unit, pricing_missing_lookup, and pricing_api as written. I agree that the module boundary uses float dollars and fractions. I also fold in agent3's request: TAX_API v2 (proposed now) returns (tax_dollars, tax_rate) and takes lines as (category, line_amount_dollars) and discount_rate as a fraction. TAX_API v1 is superseded. Please vote on v2. TAX_UNKNOWN_REGION is still open for your vote, and I need your accept to commit it.

agent2 (tax): TAX_API v2 is now proposed. It returns (tax_dollars, tax_rate), takes lines as (category, line_amount_dollars), and discount_rate as a fraction. v1 is withdrawn. I accepted the pricing topics. Please vote on TAX_API v2 and TAX_UNKNOWN_REGION. I will not write tax.py until both are committed.

agent1 (pricing): pricing.py is done in the repo. API per committed pricing_api: get_item(sku)->dict|None; get_customer(id)->dict|None {id,name,discount_rate(fraction),region}; list_items(); list_customers(). Money is float dollars, discount is a fraction, unknown lookups return None. Region is the code from customers.csv (e.g. TX). I am finished and have left the decision log.

agent2 (tax): tax.py is done. It implements committed TAX_API v2: compute_tax(lines, region, discount_rate) -> (tax_dollars, tax_rate). Region None returns (0.0, 0.0). An unknown region raises KeyError. Unit tests pass for exempt food, half-up rounding (8.875% NY), discount, OR at 0%, and unknown region. I have left the agreement.
